subtitle: A careful move. A verifiable result.
files_help: Start with an offline raw disk image. Your source stays read-only.
size_help: Leave blank to match the source. An existing image keeps its current size.
layout_help: Every partition keeps its size and position. Extra space is cleared and remains unallocated.
no_partitions: No populated partitions; the whole image will be copied.
gpt_relocate: Both GPT headers are checked. The backup table moves to the new end when needed.
mbr_preserve: The MBR, boot code and partition positions are preserved.
no_resize: Shrinking, partition expansion and filesystem conversion are unavailable.
no_physical: Physical disks and live Windows sources are unavailable in this version.
source_preserved: Your source image is never opened for writing.
review_help: Check the full destination path. This action writes only to the named image.
overwrite: All existing data in the destination image will be overwritten. Extra space will be cleared.
create_image: A new destination image will be created at this path.
confirmation: Type the destination filename to confirm
checkpoint_available: A previous checkpoint exists. Resume rechecks every committed byte before continuing.
pause_detail: Pausing finishes the current durable chunk. You can resume with the same images and size.
paused: Paused. The last saved checkpoint is ready to resume.
success_help: The copied data and partition table passed their checks. Windows bootability has not been tested.
up_to_date: You have the latest compatible version.
update_failed: Update check failed. Try again later.
restart_help: Installation restarts the app and preserves your preferences. Finish or pause migration first.
error_generic: The operation could not complete. Open the details for the cause.
size_error: Enter a whole number of MiB (1–16777216).
support_status: Snapshot creation, physical writes and boot repair are disabled.
